abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Divine Radiance
abilities.description: You channel divine influence to gain one of the following effects.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.description: A target within short range is charged with benevolent divine grace. At any point before they’ve taken their next ten-minute or longer recovery, they gain an asset to one action.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: Up to five undead creatures of level 2 or less within short range are blasted by divine radiance (make separate Intellect attack rolls against each target). Affected targets are repulsed and must spend their next turn fleeing your presence.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Affect two additional targets. Increase the maximum level of undead you can affect by 1.

abilities.name: Healing Hand
abilities.description: With a touch, you reduce one wound’s severity. A healed minor wound is gone completely, one moderate wound becomes a minor wound, or one major wound becomes a moderate wound. (If the character is at their limit of lower-severity wounds, you can’t use this ability to reduce the severity of their wounds.)

system.description:
A Dungeon Fantasy Type focused on cleric archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Fantasy. Subgenre: Dungeon Fantasy. Primary Pools: might, intellect.
